scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Watch four things: Tools: portfolio dashboards, protocol-native alerts, wallet-activity watchers, block-explorer address alerts, and official status/X accounts. Alerts should reach your phone. Positions: health factors, L.P. ranges, pegs, utilisation of markets you lend to. Protocols: governance proposals, queued upgrades (timelocks), incidents. Wallets: any outgoing transaction or new approval from your vault/operating wallets. Market: funding, large depegs, liquidations.
scenes.cap: Positions: health factors, LP ranges, pegs, utilisation of markets you lend to. Protocols: governance proposals, queued upgrades (timelocks), incidents. Wallets: any outgoing transaction or new approval from your vault/operating wallets. Market: funding, large depegs, liquidations.

scenes.title: Worked example — alert sheet
scenes.vo: health factor, credit line, < 2.0 / < 1.7, Repay per 11.3. Stablecoin peg, < 0.99 for 2h, Peg rule. Market utilisation, > 95% for 24h, Withdraw per kill rule. Vault wallet outflow, Any, Verify immediately (11.5). Queued upgrade, Any, on protocols > 10% of book, Review within timelock.

lines: Why alert on any vault-wallet outflow?
scenes.sub: Answer: The vault should almost never move; any movement could be a compromise.
